title: Router: numbered history entries with a visit id, the trail, ways back and layers
change: Start from design A's router ($SP/w1/judge-place/A/core/router.js, from $SP/w1/place/final-proto.patch). history.state = {...history.state, v, n} (l for a layer): v is this tab's visit id made once and kept in sessionStorage (from design B's stampOf), n the entry number; a state with another visit's v is a new visit; replaceState(null, ...) by a page keeps the number. Pure and exported: parse, hashOf, kindOf(first, n, cur) -> new|back|forward|reload, stampOf, sameEntry(want, had), backSteps(trail, n, href): one step when the entry just behind shows the page (query keys equal except from; a month the entry lacks is the month that page showed by itself, B's rule, no data-back-loose attribute), more steps only along one Next-result walk (every entry walked over opened with the same from), at most 10, else 0. Trail planner.trail(.sandbox) {n: {h, p, via}}, 60 entries; a new entry drops the entries Forward can no longer reach. API: entry() -> {v, n, href, kind, first}, first(), at(n), touch(), open(href, {via, replace}), back(href), layer(close) -> release(), layersOpen(), start(onChange(route, entry)). Layers: one entry at the same address, no hashchange, no redraw; Back runs the newest close(); release() steps off its entry; a stale l entry is stepped off; every layer forgotten on an address change; a link tapped with a layer open uses location.replace. app.js: router.start((route, entry) => show(route, { entry })) and ctx.layer in makeCtx(). scrollRestoration stays auto in this step. Not closed by this track alone: j-fat-fingers/x-2 (the taps track's drawer calls router.layer for the menu; the 28 row-edit views adopt ctx.layer in wave 2, plan section 3 row W1).

title: Typing memory: kept, given back, told, never crossed, let go when used
change: Design A's typing memory (remember, saved, refill, tell, forget) with three parts from design B. Watched: trusted input, change, focusin, pointerdown in capture phase on #content; drawn value taken at first focus or tap. Filed: at its first keystroke a box records the page key it was typed on (B's where + A's pageKeyOf); saves file under that key. Stored in planner.typing(.sandbox) with fmt: 1, separate from places; forms and loose boxes with locators, d (drawn) and v (typed); a day, 20 KB a page. Secrets and #/system/* never kept; [data-no-keep] honoured. Each box on its own (boxVerdict): same (the page put it back: no cue), fill, changed (let go, said once). Saved: planSig changed, within 1.5 s of the last act, inside its scope (the submitted form, a button's form, else its card, section, details or fieldset); PLUS B's save-and-leave rule (usedBy): a tap that saved the plan and changed the address with no newer touch lets go of its own form's typing and of every box in no form on that page. Given back quietly (.value, input/change, never reportValidity), shut sections holding a filled box opened, '.place-hint' "Not saved yet · Undo my typing" beside the buttons, '.place-cue' under a far box. B's observer: one MutationObserver on #content off while the shell clears or draws (busy/idle with takeRecords) and before the page is drawn; a typed box the page removes (not by its Cancel or submit) is kept under its page; the same form drawn again at once gets its typing back quietly; otherwise (a stray tap) the bottom note says AT ONCE "Not saved yet: what you typed in “Edit Ana's salary”." with "Open it" (info kind) and the line is drawn at that form's row. tell() on arrival: one '.notice.info.place-kept' line where the form lives with "Open it" (presses the recorded opener) and "Undo my typing"; the bottom note repeats it only when the line is not readable once the place is restored and the screen is still (A showed both in the judge's D1). A same-page redraw (a month chip) keeps unseen typing silently. Forgotten: Save, a Cancel/Close/Never mind/Discard button of that form, Undo my typing (boxes back to drawn values with events), a day. store subscription: planSig(before) !== planSig(after) -> place.saved(). base.css: .place-hint, .place-cue, .place-kept (shell selectors).
